name: Firepit
description: A woman in her fifties who holds court by the backyard fire pit telling stories, warm and unhurried, with a voice like smoke; she sings folk ballads.
build: A sturdy average adult woman's build of ordinary proportions: soft rounded shoulders, a solid torso, arms and legs of ordinary length, standing upright with straight knees.
face: Fair weathered skin with rosy cheeks, grey-blue eyes under soft grey-brown brows, a strong straight nose, laugh lines at the eye corners, and thin lips.
hair: Thick silver-grey hair in one heavy loose braid hanging forward over the character-left shoulder to the chest, a few strands loose at the temples.
outfit: A heavy rust-orange wool shawl wrapped over both shoulders and knotted at the chest, its edges ending at the elbows so both forearms and hands are bare; under it a forest-green long-sleeved knit top with the sleeves pushed up to the elbows; straight dark-denim jeans; brown leather ankle boots. Her head is bare.
performance_style: Grounded and calm: feet hip-width apart, weight even. The character-left hand holds a big solid cream enamel camp mug at waist height, the character-right hand open and empty at her side, fingers visible. Head level, a warm knowing half-smile.
location: A backyard fire pit at night: a ring of stones with a low orange fire in the centre foreground, trimmed lawn running to the bottom of the frame, a half-circle of lawn chairs, dark trees behind and a strand of warm string lights over the fence.
recognition_cues: a heavy rust-orange wool shawl knotted at the chest
one heavy silver-grey braid over the character-left shoulder
a big cream enamel camp mug
avoid: steam or smoke rising from the mug

sing.intent: Folk-ballad vocal loop: sway slowly side to side, raise the mic in the character-right hand to the mouth for a long phrase, lift the mug in the character-left hand a little at chest height on the swell, then return to the calm stance. The mouth visibly opens wide and changes shape across the loop so she unmistakably reads as singing.

animations.flinch: A log cracks in the fire: her shoulders lift and she draws the mug to her chest, then settles back into the calm stance. No opponent, strike or contact.
animations.guard: One-shot stage self-protection: draw the shawl-covered shoulders in, hold the mug close at the chest in the character-left hand and raise the character-right open hand, holding a steady stance. Not combat.
animations.entrance: One-shot entrance: amble in, lift the mug in a small toast, then settle into the calm stance.
